subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by `artifacts.download` use the existing `operator.read` artifact contract, or require an `operator.admin` exception?
rationale: This is a persistent Gateway authorization contract, not a mechanical implementation detail; the correct scope determines user access, protocol wording, UI recovery behavior, and the tests that must govern upgrades.

options.title: Use `operator.read` with strict bindings
options.body: Adopt the branch's proposed read scope only when the session, record, managed URL, transcript reference, and coordinates all match.

options.title: Require `operator.admin`
options.body: Treat managed local-byte retrieval as an administrative exception and update the handler, protocol documentation, UI recovery, and authorization tests together.

recommendation.title: Use `operator.read` with strict bindings
recommendation.body: Adopt the branch's proposed read scope only when the session, record, managed URL, transcript reference, and coordinates all match.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR discussion specifically requests this person's Gateway authorization-contract confirmation.
